description:
Sets the commercial status of an invoice. Any transition other than the ones below is
rejected.

- **`PAID`:** from `ISSUED`, `SENT` or `OVERDUE`.
- **`SENT`:** from `ISSUED`.
- **`ISSUED`:** from `SENT` only, to undo a `SENT` set by mistake.
- **Not set here:** issuing and voiding are fiscal acts with their own operations
  (`POST …/{invoice_id}/issue`, `POST …/{invoice_id}/void`), and issuing is never undone.

Endpoint: PUT /v1/companies/{company_id}/invoices/{invoice_id}/status

⚠️ Read before calling:
- The status names, the proforma lifecycle, and which tool performs each operation. (resource: beel://guardrails/invoice-state-machine)

IBAN.description:
IBAN (International Bank Account Number).
Required when payment method is BANK_TRANSFER.

method.description:
Preferred payment method. Omitted, `BANK_TRANSFER` applies.
If NONE is selected, no payment information will be shown on the invoice.

payment_term_days.description:
Payment term in days. When marking an invoice as paid, every field of this object
that travels replaces the stored one and every omitted field keeps its current value.

PaymentMethod.description:
Payment method shown on invoices and recurring invoices.

- `NONE`: no payment information is shown.
- `BANK_TRANSFER`: bank transfer to the IBAN of the payment details; the only method
  that requires an IBAN.
- `CARD`: card payment.
- `CASH`: cash payment.
- `CHECK`: payment by cheque.
- `DIRECT_DEBIT`: direct debit from the customer's bank account.
- `BIZUM`: payment through Bizum.
- `OTHER`: any other method.

SetInvoiceStatusRequest.description:
Replaces the status of an invoice. The valid transitions are the same ones the dedicated
verbs used to expose, and the domain still rejects any transition that is not allowed.

payment_date.description: Payment date. Only read when `status` is `PAID`; defaults to today.

payment_method.description:
Payment details object. Only read when `status` is `PAID`. Example:
`{ "method": "BANK_TRANSFER", "iban": "ES9121000418450200051332" }`

sent_at.description:
Timestamp for when the invoice was sent. Only read when `status` is `SENT`;
defaults to now.

status.description:
Target status.

- **PAID**: from `ISSUED`, `SENT` or `OVERDUE`.
- **SENT**: from `ISSUED`. Records `sent_at`.
- **ISSUED**: from `SENT` only. Clears `sent_at`. Use it to undo a `SENT` set by
  mistake; it never un-issues an invoice, which is irreversible.

company_id.description: Unique identifier (UUID) of the company the operation acts on — its identifier, not its NIF. It is the only source of context: the account that owns it is derived from it, and the `BeeL-Active-Company` header plays no part. A company you do not reach answers `403`, and so does a company that does not exist, so the existence of a company in another account is never disclosed.

name: beel_set_invoice_status
